It is however noticed that certain inadvertent typographical/arithmetical errors (linkage errors) have crept in our order dated 5.4.2023, while considering the values for depreciation, repayment of loan and calculation of interest on working capital. Therefore, in terms of the Regulation 111 read with Regulation 103A of the CERC (Conduct of Business) Regulations 1999, these inadvertent errors are being rectified, as stated in the subsequent paragraphs. 3. Further, for computation of ECR, the Cost of Limestone, which was inadvertently considered as Rs. 0.000028 /KWh, is corrected as Rs. 0.028 / KWh.
